Types, Control Flow, and Functions
nodes.description: Basic syntax of Java including static typing, loops, conditionals, and defining static methods.

nodes.name: Classes and Object Instantiation
nodes.description: Creating classes, instance variables, constructors, and instantiating objects using the 'new' keyword.

nodes.name: Reference Types vs Primitive Types
nodes.description: Understanding how primitive types store values directly while reference types store memory addresses (pointers).

nodes.name: Singly Linked Lists (SLList)
nodes.description: Building chains of nodes connected by forward pointers, hiding raw recursive list nodes via a wrapper class.
nodes.visual_hint: Box-and-pointer singly linked list of nodes with forward pointers.

nodes.name: Doubly Linked Lists with Sentinels
nodes.description: Improving list operations with backward pointers and a sentinel node to avoid null pointer edge cases.
nodes.visual_hint: Doubly linked list with backward pointers and a sentinel node.

nodes.name: Fixed-Size Arrays
nodes.description: Contiguous memory structures with constant time indexing and fixed capacity.

nodes.name: Resizing Arrays (ArrayList)
nodes.description: Dynamically resizing arrays through geometric expansion to achieve amortized constant time appends.
nodes.visual_hint: Geometrically resize an array on overflow (amortised growth).

nodes.name: Unit Testing with JUnit
nodes.description: Writing automated tests using JUnit assertions to verify component behaviors in isolation.

nodes.name: Interfaces and Overriding
nodes.description: Defining strict behavioral contracts (APIs) and implementing them via method overriding.

nodes.name: Implementation Inheritance (Extends)
nodes.description: Reusing code by inheriting fields and methods from a superclass using the 'extends' keyword.

nodes.name: Subtype Polymorphism and Dynamic Dispatch
nodes.description: Using supertype variables to hold subtype objects, relying on dynamic method selection at runtime.
nodes.name_zh: 子类型多态与动态分派

nodes.name: Iterators and Iterables
nodes.description: Implementing the Iterable and Iterator interfaces to allow standard 'for-each' loop functionality.

nodes.name: Quick Find
nodes.description: An array-based approach to the Union-Find problem optimizing for constant-time connectivity checks.

nodes.name: Quick Union
nodes.description: Using a parent-link forest representation to optimize connection speeds at the cost of find times.
nodes.visual_hint: Union-Find as a parent-link forest; union and find operations.

nodes.name: Weighted Quick Union
nodes.description: Preventing tall trees by always linking the root of the smaller tree to the root of the larger tree.
nodes.visual_hint: Weighted quick-union linking the smaller tree under the larger.

nodes.name: Path Compression
nodes.description: Flattening the tree dynamically during find operations to achieve practically constant time operations.
nodes.visual_hint: Flatten the union-find tree during find via path compression.

nodes.name: Big-Theta, Big-O, Big-Omega
nodes.description: Formalizing runtime bounding: upper bounds (O), lower bounds (Omega), and tight bounds (Theta).
nodes.visual_hint: Plot O, Omega, and Theta bounds sandwiching a running time.

nodes.name: Loop and Summation Analysis
nodes.description: Analyzing nested loops by translating them into mathematical summations and resolving bounds.

nodes.name: Recursive Runtime Analysis
nodes.description: Determining the time complexity of recursive functions through recurrence trees and geometric series.

nodes.name: Tree Definitions and Traversals
nodes.description: Understanding rooted trees, depths, heights, and Pre-order, In-order, Post-order traversals.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate pre-order, in-order, and post-order tree traversals.

nodes.name: Binary Search Tree Invariant
nodes.description: The rule that all left descendants are strictly less than the node, and all right descendants are strictly greater.

nodes.name: BST Search, Insert, and Delete
nodes.description: Implementing search, insertion, and Hibbard deletion within a BST structure.
nodes.visual_hint: Search, insert, and Hibbard-delete in a binary search tree.

nodes.name: Tree Rotation
nodes.description: Local structural transformations (rotateLeft, rotateRight) that preserve BST invariants while modifying height.
nodes.visual_hint: Rotate a BST node left and right preserving the search order.

nodes.name: B-Trees (2-3 Trees)
nodes.description: Perfectly balanced search trees with overstuffed nodes and splitting mechanics to maintain O(log N) heights.

nodes.name: Left-Leaning Red-Black Trees
nodes.description: BST isomers of 2-3 trees that enforce balance through color invariants and local rotations.
nodes.visual_hint: Insert into a left-leaning red-black tree with rotations and colour flips.

nodes.name: Hash Functions and Object.hashCode()
nodes.description: Mapping arbitrary data types to integers deterministically while minimizing collisions.

nodes.name: Separate Chaining
nodes.description: Resolving hash collisions by storing multiple key-value pairs in buckets (usually linked lists) at each array index.
nodes.visual_hint: Resolve hash collisions by chaining entries in buckets.

nodes.name: Linear Probing
nodes.description: Resolving collisions via open addressing, scanning sequentially forward in the array for an empty slot.
nodes.visual_hint: Resolve collisions by linear probing to the next open slot.

nodes.name: Load Factor and Resizing
nodes.description: Monitoring the items-to-buckets ratio and dynamically doubling array size when it crosses a threshold.

nodes.name: Priority Queue ADT
nodes.description: An Abstract Data Type enabling efficient insertion and removal of the 'smallest' or 'largest' elements.

nodes.name: Binary Min/Max Heaps
nodes.description: Complete binary trees fulfilling the heap property (parents always smaller than children in min-heaps).
nodes.visual_hint: Swim and sink nodes to maintain a binary heap.

nodes.name: Swim, Sink, and Insert/Delete
nodes.description: Promoting or demoting nodes to restore heap invariants after insertion or deletion of the root.

nodes.name: Array Representation of Heaps
nodes.description: Flattening a complete binary tree into an array via arithmetic index relations (e.g. leftChild = 2k).
nodes.visual_hint: Map a complete binary heap onto an array by index arithmetic.

nodes.name: Graph API and Adjacency Lists
nodes.description: Modeling networks using vertices and edges, predominantly mapped in memory using Adjacency Lists.

nodes.name: Depth-First Search (DFS)
nodes.description: Exploring graphs deeply by following paths to their ends before backtracking, inherently recursive.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate depth-first search exploring a graph with backtracking.

nodes.name: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
nodes.description: Exploring graphs broadly layer-by-layer using a queue, implicitly computing unweighted shortest paths.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate breadth-first search exploring a graph layer by layer with a queue.

nodes.name: Topological Sort
nodes.description: Linearizing a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) using post-order DFS to process dependencies sequentially.
nodes.visual_hint: Linearise a DAG by post-order DFS into a topological order.

nodes.name: Edge Relaxation
nodes.description: Updating the shortest known distance to a vertex if passing through an intermediate vertex yields a better path.

nodes.name: Dijkstra's Algorithm
nodes.description: A greedy shortest-path algorithm for non-negative edge weights utilizing a priority queue of distances.
nodes.visual_hint: Run Dijkstra's algorithm relaxing edges with a priority queue.

nodes.name: A* Search Algorithm
nodes.description: An optimized variant of Dijkstra's algorithm that biases search directions using a heuristic estimate.
nodes.visual_hint: Run A* search biasing exploration with a heuristic on a grid.

nodes.name: Cut Property
nodes.description: The foundational theorem proving that the minimum weight crossing edge in any cut belongs to the MST.

nodes.name: Prim's Algorithm
nodes.description: Growing an MST incrementally outward from a starting vertex, highly similar to Dijkstra's algorithm.
nodes.visual_hint: Grow a minimum spanning tree outward with Prim's algorithm.

nodes.name: Kruskal's Algorithm
nodes.description: Building an MST by sorting edges globally and adding them unless they create cycles (checked via Disjoint Sets).
nodes.visual_hint: Build an MST by adding sorted edges that avoid cycles (Kruskal).

nodes.name: 1D Range Searching
nodes.description: Finding all points within a 1-dimensional bounded range efficiently using a standard BST.

nodes.name: K-D Trees
nodes.description: Multi-dimensional spatial partitioning trees where each level discriminates along an alternating spatial axis.
nodes.visual_hint: Partition the plane recursively with a 2-D tree.

nodes.name: Trie Structure
nodes.description: A character-based prefix tree structure offering fast multi-way branches for string storage and retrieval.
nodes.visual_hint: Prefix tree (trie) branching strings by character.

nodes.name: Trie String Operations
nodes.description: Algorithms traversing the trie for operations like longest prefix matching and auto-complete collection.

nodes.name: Selection and Insertion Sort
nodes.description: Basic O(N^2) sorting algorithms; Insertion sort is particularly efficient on nearly sorted arrays.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate selection and insertion sort rearranging an array.

nodes.name: Merge Sort
nodes.description: A stable O(N log N) divide-and-conquer sort that recursively merges sorted sub-arrays.
nodes.visual_hint: Recursively split and merge an array (merge sort).

nodes.name: Quicksort
nodes.description: An in-place divide-and-conquer sort utilizing a pivot to partition elements, operating fast in practice.
nodes.visual_hint: Partition around a pivot and recurse (quicksort).

nodes.name: Lower Bounds of Comparison Sorting
nodes.description: Mathematical proof establishing that comparison-based sorting algorithms cannot be faster than Omega(N log N).

nodes.name: Counting Sort
nodes.description: An O(N+R) non-comparison sort that tallies occurrences of discrete integer values in a frequency array.
nodes.visual_hint: Tally counts and place keys for counting sort.

nodes.name: LSD Radix Sort
nodes.description: Sorting values digit-by-digit moving from the Least Significant Digit upwards, using stable counting sort.
nodes.visual_hint: Sort keys digit by digit from the least significant digit.

nodes.name: MSD Radix Sort
nodes.description: Sorting by Most Significant Digit first, recursively subdividing inputs into buckets like a Trie.
